"They watched the passing of that bloodstained argosy through their streets with dark and solemn eyes. Those riders seemed journeyed from a legendary world and they left behind a strange tainture like an afterimage on the eye and the air they disturbed was altered and electric."

The book I think has inspired me the most is 'The Court of the Air' by Stephen Hunt. The book is set in a world that is incredibly well imagined. Everything from transport to politics is there, the entire culture of various different groups is expressed in detail, but it never feels like it's losing the story to show off the world.

The characters are well developed and unique, from the multi-bodied king steam, to the prince of jackals that will ascend to a fate worse than death in his eyes.

It's probably my favourite book right now and it really is a fantasy that gives an incredibly vivid view of an entirely different world.

It also has a steampunky theme. But with magic too.
